import { Compiler } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.5/dist/mindar-image.prod.js'; const dropzone = document.getElementById('dropzone'); const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput'); const loadDefaultBtn = document.getElementById('loadDefaultBtn'); const compileBtn = document.getElementById('compileBtn'); const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('downloadBtn'); const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progressContainer'); const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar'); const progressStatus = document.getElementById('progressStatus'); const progressPercent = document.getElementById('progressPercent'); const previewCanvas = document.getElementById('previewCanvas'); const placeholderTxt = document.getElementById('placeholderTxt'); const logBox = document.getElementById('logBox'); const statDim = document.getElementById('statDim'); const statAspect = document.getElementById('statAspect'); const statPoints = document.getElementById('statPoints'); const statQuality = document.getElementById('statQuality'); const statSize = document.getElementById('statSize'); let currentImg = null; let compiledBuffer = null; let compilerInstance = null; function log(msg, highlight = false) { const div = document.createElement('div'); div.className = 'log-item' + (highlight ? ' highlight' : ''); div.textContent = `> ${msg}`; logBox.appendChild(div); logBox.scrollTop = logBox.scrollHeight; } // Dropzone handlers dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click()); dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.add('dragover'); }); dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropzone.classList.remove('dragover')); dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.remove('dragover'); if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) { handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]); } }); fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => { if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) { handleFile(e.target.files[0]); } }); loadDefaultBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => { log('Loading default poster: /assets/event-poster.jpg'); try { const res = await fetch('./assets/event-poster.jpg'); const blob = await res.blob(); handleFile(new File([blob], 'event-poster.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' })); } catch (err) { log(`Failed to load default poster: ${err.message}`); } }); function handleFile(file) { log(`Selected file: ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`); const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = (e) => { const img = new Image(); img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; img.onload = () => { currentImg = img; compileBtn.disabled = false; downloadBtn.disabled = true; compiledBuffer = null; statDim.textContent = `${img.naturalWidth} × ${img.naturalHeight} px`; const aspect = (img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight).toFixed(3); statAspect.textContent = `${aspect} (${img.naturalWidth > img.naturalHeight ? 'Landscape' : 'Portrait'})`; statPoints.textContent = 'Ready to extract'; statQuality.innerHTML = 'Awaiting compile'; statSize.textContent = '—'; drawPreview(img); log('Poster loaded into canvas. Click Compile to extract features.'); }; img.src = e.target.result; }; reader.readAsDataURL(file); } function drawPreview(img, points = []) { placeholderTxt.style.display = 'none'; previewCanvas.style.display = 'block'; const maxW = 500; const scale = Math.min(1, maxW / img.naturalWidth); const w = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * scale); const h = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * scale); previewCanvas.width = w; previewCanvas.height = h; const ctx = previewCanvas.getContext('2d'); // Draw base image slightly dimmed ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4, 5, 8, 0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); // Draw detected points if (points.length > 0) { points.forEach((pt) => { const px = pt.x * scale; const py = pt.y * scale; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#00f0ff'; ctx.fill(); }); } } compileBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => { if (!currentImg) return; compileBtn.disabled = true; loadDefaultBtn.disabled = true; progressContainer.style.display = 'block'; progressBar.style.width = '0%'; progressPercent.textContent = '0%'; progressStatus.textContent = 'Extracting feature descriptors...'; log('Starting MindAR feature compilation...', true); try { compilerInstance = new Compiler(); await compilerInstance.compileImageTargets([currentImg], (percent) => { const p = Math.min(100, Math.round(percent)); progressBar.style.width = `${p}%`; progressPercent.textContent = `${p}%`; if (p < 50) { progressStatus.textContent = `Stage 1/2: Multi-scale keypoints (${p * 2}%)`; } else { progressStatus.textContent = `Stage 2/2: Building optical tracker (${(p - 50) * 2}%)`; } }); log('Feature extraction completed! Generating binary target...', true); compiledBuffer = await compilerInstance.exportData(); const byteSize = compiledBuffer.byteLength; statSize.textContent = `${(byteSize / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`; // Extract feature points for visualization let totalPoints = 0; const visualPoints = []; if (compilerInstance.data && compilerInstance.data[0]) { const matchData = compilerInstance.data[0].matchingData; if (matchData) { matchData.forEach(item => { if (item.points) { totalPoints += item.points.length; item.points.forEach(pt => { visualPoints.push({ x: pt.x, y: pt.y }); }); } }); } } statPoints.textContent = `${totalPoints} keypoints`; if (totalPoints > 400) { statQuality.innerHTML = '★★★★★ Excellent'; } else if (totalPoints > 150) { statQuality.innerHTML = '★★★★ Good'; } else { statQuality.innerHTML = '★★★ Moderate'; } drawPreview(currentImg, visualPoints); downloadBtn.disabled = false; progressStatus.textContent = 'Compilation complete!'; log(`Success! Target compiled with ${totalPoints} features (${(byteSize / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB).`, true); // Auto-save to /targets/event-poster.mind via Vite middleware try { const saveRes = await fetch('/__save_mind', { method: 'POST', body: compiledBuffer }); if (saveRes.ok) { log('✓ Automatically saved target to /targets/event-poster.mind!', true); } } catch (saveErr) { console.warn('Auto-save endpoint notice:', saveErr); } } catch (err) { console.error(err); progressStatus.textContent = 'Error during compilation'; log(`Compilation failed: ${err.message}`); } finally { compileBtn.disabled = false; loadDefaultBtn.disabled = false; } }); downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!compiledBuffer) return; const blob = new Blob([compiledBuffer], { type: 'application/octet-stream' }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'event-poster.mind'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); log('Downloaded "event-poster.mind"'); }); // Automatically load default poster on open window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { loadDefaultBtn.click(); }); // Expose compile function globally for automation / headless tasks window.__autoCompileDefault = async function() { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); compileBtn.click(); return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const check = setInterval(() => { if (compiledBuffer) { clearInterval(check); resolve(compiledBuffer); } }, 500); }); };
